description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes related to blame analysis in a version control system, including structures for blame origins, blame entries, and the blame scoreboard.

classes.name: blame_origin
classes.description: Represents a suspected blob in a commit, including reference counting, linked list pointers, commit info, suspects, and file details.

classes.name: blame_entry
classes.description: Represents a group of lines in the blame analysis, linked to a blame origin, with line number info and significance score.

classes.name: blame_bloom_data
classes.description: Placeholder for blame bloom filter data, details not specified in the header.

classes.name: blame_scoreboard
classes.description: Tracks the current state of blame assignment, including commit info, buffers, statistics, thresholds, flags, and callback functions.

methods.name: blame_origin_incref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a blame_origin object.

methods.name: blame_origin_decref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a blame_origin object and frees it if count reaches zero.

methods.name: blame_coalesce
methods.description: Coalesces blame entries in the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_sort_final
methods.description: Sorts the blame entries in the final order.

methods.name: blame_entry_score
methods.description: Calculates the score of a blame entry.

methods.name: assign_blame
methods.description: Performs blame assignment based on the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_nth_line
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the nth line in the blame analysis.

methods.name: setup_scoreboard
methods.description: Sets up the blame scoreboard with initial data.

methods.name: cleanup_scoreboard
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the scoreboard.

methods.name: blame_entry_prepend
methods.description: Prepends a new blame entry to a list.

methods.name: get_blame_suspects
methods.description: Retrieves suspects for a given commit.
